title: Styles side by side (1)
text:
# Styles side by side

What separates the styles is not the BPM: at 200 BPM hi-tech and dark psycore overlap, and the character decides
(`R03/findings.md:18-21`, `decisao_diogo` in
`estilos/geral.md:200`). This table is the map; the style
sheets hold the detail. **Keep these numbers as they are:** the templates and the AICORE style-range database read them.

Each cell carries the status of its source (see How to read the status):
`codigo` = in Core's templates or contracts; `decisao_diogo` = approved by ear; `estudo` / `online` / `hipotese` = not yet.

title: Styles side by side · Two sets of style names
text:

title: Style sheet — Dark psycore
text:
# Style sheet — Dark psycore

Main source: `inbox/core-improvements/conhecimento/estilos/darkpsycore.md`.
Core templates: `darkpsycore` (225), `-minimal` (210),
`-dense` (240), `-syncopated` (255).

title: Style sheet — Dark psycore · Identity
text:
200–260 BPM, typical 225 (`decisao_diogo`). Dark, dense, dry rolling KBBB, growl, acid in call and response, drone
in the breaks (`decisao_diogo`). It was born in dark psy at 150–155; what it brings up is density and articulation.
Below 200 it becomes hi-tech; above 260 it leaves the style (`estudo`, `darkpsycore.md:236`).

title: Style sheet — Dark psycore · Rhythm
text:
- Kick on the four beats, gate 160 ticks, shorter than psy; a ghost on the last 16th only at energy ≥ 3 (`codigo`).
- Bass: kbbb / kbb / kb-b, a note between 0.5 and 0.6 of the gap and **never longer than 32–45 ms**; root MIDI 26–36;
  turns `[0, 1, 0, −2]` every 4 bars (`codigo`).
- Hats: 16ths with 1/32 rolls on step 15, or 3/7/11/15 in the dense one. No swing, nothing off the grid (`decisao_diogo`).
- Percussion on steps 3/7/11/13/15; accents on 6/22/27, the accent falling from 500 to 90 Hz (`codigo`).

title: Style sheet — Dark psycore · Sound
text:
- Engine kick: pitchStart 250–300, pitchEnd 44–50, pitchDecay 16–24, ampDecay 110–150, click 0.45–0.65,
  drive 0.3–0.45; reference fundamental 54–59 Hz (`codigo`, `darkpsycore.md:46`).
- Engine bass: envAmount 4.5–5.8, filterDecay 30–45, decay 36–48, release 4–7, drive 0.4–0.65, sub 0.25–0.4,
  reference peak 65 Hz (`codigo`, `:47`). In Core the bass is a sample of Diogo's in the Sampler or a **W-Core** bass
  preset: *Dark Plonk*, *Dark Rubber*, *Dark Bite* (values).
- Bass chain: saturation 10 / 0.6 / −4 → compressor −20 dB 5:1 att 1 rel 40 → mono below 140 Hz (`codigo`).
- Growl: on the third note of the KBBB, with a bigger envAmount and filterDecay, more saturation and a mid EQ, or a
  moving formant (`codigo`, `:231`). In Core: **GROWL** (*KBBB talk*, *Night talk*) on the bass, which keeps the sub
  clean below Body; **BODY** for warmth above 150 Hz, **never on the sub**; W-Core *Squelch 303* for the acid.
- Texture "Growl": octave −1, res 0.85, drive 0.9, saturation 12/0.7/−6, HP 150, reverb 0.6. Lead "Acid": cutoff 600,
  res 0.88, envAmount 5.5, filterDecay 90, drive 0.6, HP 200 + delay 0.75. Drone: attack 200 / release 2000,
  reverb 0.95 with mix 0.6 (`codigo`). In Core: W-Core · Wave pads and drones (*Dark Choir*, *Abyss Drone*)
  with Core FX reverb.
- Style racks: `growl-talk`, `dark-spiral-lead`, `dark-room`, `hats-flange`, `metal-hits`, now played by their native
  replacements (GROWL, Core FX *Dark spiral* and *Tension phaser*, R-Core *Dark room*, METAL *Key hits*; list) — all `hypothesis`.
- Strong Core devices: GROWL, METAL (follows the bass key), GLITCH in the fills, Core FX *Dark spiral* on the accents, a short reverb (Core FX *Dark room*).

title: Style sheet — Dark psycore · Working it in Core, plugin by plugin
text:
From the guide Diogo brought on 2026-11-08 (`externo`); every preset and knob below exists in core-main
(`app/domain/src/wcore.cpp`, `edit.cpp`, `rcore.cpp`). Not heard as a whole yet.

- **Low end:** the kick owns everything below 80 Hz; the bass is high-passed around 60–80 Hz and the sub is never
  widened, the low end stays mono. The templates go a little further: the Bass track's high-pass sits at 90 Hz and
  the growl layer's at 150 Hz (`codigo`).
- **Bass:** a heavy bass sample of Diogo's in the Sampler, or W-Core *Dark Plonk* / *Dark Rubber* / *Dark Bite*
  (B-Core is gone, core-main #240). At 225 BPM a 1/16 is 67 ms: keep `env1Decay` and the note gate short so each
  note ends before the next kick; a short envelope link to `pitch` gives the plonk.
- **Growl (GROWL):** *KBBB talk* on the bass or on a mid bass layer, as the templates do with their *Bass growl*
  track: moving vowels on the top of the bass, the sub left clean below the **Body (clean below)** knob.
- **Metal (METAL):** *Key hits* or *Rust* on percussion and accents. Set **Note** to the root of the bass so the
  metal rings in key (a preset sets it to 30, D1).
- **Glitch (GLITCH):** *Fill 1/16* or *Broken 1/32* on the percussion steps (3/7/11/13/15). Automate **Chance** up for
  the fills and back to 0 for the drop.
- **Space (R-Core / SPACE):** *Dark room*, short and dark. A big reverb kills the articulation and muddies the fast
  low end.

title: Style sheet — Dark psycore · A first pass in Core
text:
Load `darkpsycore` (225). Solo Kick and Bass. In P-Core write a strict `kbbb`. On the bass shorten the notes (gate and
`env1Decay`) until each one stops just before the next kick (ENV 2 → tone does not shorten the note: it sets how far
the filter opens at the start, so it changes the brightness of the hit). Once that dry roll is locked, add GROWL and METAL on parallel
tracks or sends for the dark texture.

title: Style sheet — Dark psycore · Structure and energy
text:
384 bars: Intro 32 (1), Groove 64 (3), Development 96 (4), Break 32 (0), Return 96 (4), Outro 64 (2) (`codigo`).
A fill in the last bar of each 16-bar phrase; one bar without kick before each lift; riser and master high-pass sweep
in the 4 bars before the lift; an impact on the first beat of the new section; a drone in the Intro and the Break; a
fade from −6 to −40 dB over the last half (`codigo`, `:28-33`). In Core the riser and the sweep are F-Core's
*Build-up* intent; the impact is F-Core's *Impact*.

title: Style sheet — Dark psycore · Levels and master
text:
Approved on 2026-11-04 (`decisao_diogo`, `:70`): kick 0, bass +9, hats −32.7, open-hats −22.8, perc −10, accents −27,
lead −10.8, texture −15, atmos −11, impact −6, riser −10 — utility trims at the end of each chain, faders at 0.
Hats about 10 dB below version D. Approved master: `darkpsycore-streaming`, utility drive +8.58 dB, HP 30 Hz,
notch 240 Hz (`decisao_diogo`, `:76`). Measured reference: 190 BPM, −10.5 LUFS, +0.8 dBTP, crest 12.0; the bass sits
−1.2 to −0.3 dB against the kick in the low end (`medido`). The Core-only template values are on its
template page.

title: Style sheet — Dark psycore · Samples
text:
Kick 46–59 Hz with a 110–150 ms tail, ending before 267 ms and ideally before the first 1/16 (67 ms); a short bass,
MIDI 26–36, cut at 32–45 ms; hats 9.5–11.5 kHz with 12–20 ms; metallic FX, growls and drones, `dark, long`
(`hipotese`, `:210-214`). Find them in the sample database (`style = 'darkpsycore'`).

title: Style sheet — Dark psycore · Out of the style (`estudo`)
text:
Long bass notes that touch the next one; bass over the kick; offbeat or polyrhythmic kicks; hats off the grid or
swung; BPM  260 for the whole track; long breaks without a drone; sidechain on the master; width in the
low end (`:236`).
The 2026-11-08 guide adds two (`externo`): stereo wideners or Haas effects on the bass, and long shimmer reverbs in
the drop (they kill the fast transients).

title: Style sheet — Dark psycore · Status and what is missing
text:
BPM, character, levels and master: `decisao_diogo`. Rhythm, sound, structure and chains: `codigo` (from the
templates, not heard as finished music). Samples and plugin fit: `hipotese`. Missing: listening to the fills and
drops, and the "out of the style" list was never tested against a real track. The online sub-genres disagree with
Core (dark psy 150+/140–155, psycore 190–250/170–250/170–220, forest 150–160/145–152) — `:244-246`, and here Diogo decides.

title: Style sheet — Hi-tech
text:
# Style sheet — Hi-tech

Main source: `inbox/core-improvements/conhecimento/estilos/hitech.md`.
Core templates: `hitech` (190), `-minimal` (175),
`-dense` (205), `-triplets` (220).

title: Style sheet — Hi-tech · Identity
text:
170–220 BPM, typical 190 (`decisao_diogo`). Dry, clicky, fast and articulated, with metal; born in dark psy at
150–155. The range is narrow on purpose: a big change becomes another style (`:9-15`).

title: Style sheet — Hi-tech · Rhythm
text:
- Kick on the four beats, gate 160 ticks — shorter than psy — with a dry attack (`codigo`, `:36`).
- Bass: kbbb / kbb / triplet, a note of 0.55–0.6 of the gap, **never longer than 40–50 ms**; root MIDI 31–46; turns
  with octaves `[0, 12, 0, 3]` (`codigo`, `:35`).
- Hats: straight 16ths with 1/32 rolls (steps 7/15; 3/7/11/15 in the dense one). The style with most hats (`codigo`, `:37`).
- Glitch on the percussion on steps 1/5/9/12/13 with delay 0.125 and feedback 0.5; accents on 3/10/19/26/29 (`codigo`, `:39-40`).

title: Style sheet — Hi-tech · Sound
text:
- Engine kick: pitchStart 320–370, pitchEnd 52–58, pitchDecay 11–16, ampDecay 80–110, click 0.65–0.8,
  drive 0.28–0.38; reference fundamental 45–48 Hz (`codigo`, `:44`).
- Engine bass: envAmount 4.5–5.5, filterDecay 30–40, decay 40–48, release 5–7, drive 0.35–0.5, sub 0.2–0.3,
  peak 46–59 Hz (`codigo`, `:45`). In Core: a sample of Diogo's in the Sampler or the **W-Core** bass presets
  *Full Speed Saw*, *Full Speed Punch* and *Full Speed Deep* (values).
- Bass chain: saturation 9 / 0.5 / −3 → compressor −18 dB 6:1 att 1 rel 35 → mono below 140 Hz (`codigo`, `:55`).
- Lead "Zap": octave +2, cutoff 1000, res 0.8, envAmount 6.5, filterDecay 40, delay 0.375 ping-pong, reverb ≤ 0.12
  (`codigo`, `:48`). The **texture** is the "FM answer": octave +1, delay 0.75 with feedback 0.5, reverb 0.7 mix 0.3 (`:49`).
- The **click is the style's signature**: **PUNCH** (Click up, or Clip for force; presets per style). Half of the
  character comes from **ZAP** (lasers, *Laser*), **METAL** (comb, ring and resonator in one, *Glass bells*) and
  **GROWL** (formant); **PULSE** before the drop; **Core FX** (*Laser fall*, a short *Tight room*) for controlled space.
  (values).
- Avoid: long shimmer and long reverbs — "a big reverb kills the articulation" (`decisao_diogo`). Never a Haas widener
  on the bass (it ruins the mono).
- Style racks: `zap-laser`, `glitch-stutter`, `lead-motion`, `kick-click` now played by their native replacements (list) — `hypothesis`.
- Leads and FM bells: W-Core · Wave (*Glass FM Lead*, *Static Riser*, *Laser Zap*, *Hi-tech Blip*).

title: Style sheet — Hi-tech · Structure and energy
text:
320 bars: Intro 32 (1), Groove 64 (3), Development 64 (4), Break 32 (0), Main 96 (4), Outro 32 (2) (`codigo`, `:27`).
Riser as a geometric ramp of 2→48 notes over 4 bars; master high-pass sweep up to 900 Hz; one bar without kick before
the lift; an impact on the first beat (`codigo`, `:28-31`). Break ×0.9–0.95 and drop ×1.1–1.15, for example 190→220
and 220→180, with an 8-bar riser ramp (`codigo`, `:15`).

title: Style sheet — Hi-tech · Levels and master
text:
Approved on 2026-11-04 — "agora sim" (`decisao_diogo`, `:66`): kick 0, bass +9, hats −22.8, open-hats −15, perc −15.8,
accents −27, lead −10.5, texture −15, atmos −11, impact −6, riser −10; master −11.7 LUFS.
Approved master: `hitech-streaming`, utility drive +12 dB and the preset's utility +4.9 dB, ceiling −1.4 since
core-main #40, HP 38 Hz, notch 200 Hz, and the 2nd EQ at −2.5 dB at 3.2 kHz Q4 — the squelch band (`decisao_diogo`, `:74`).
Measured reference: 175 BPM, −7.4 LUFS, +1.3 dBTP, crest 9.7, bass −2.4 dB against the kick in the low end (`medido`, `:79`).
The Core-only template keeps HP 38, the 3.2 kHz cut, utility +4.9 and the −1.4 ceiling: see its
master chain.

title: Style sheet — Hi-tech · Samples
text:
A strong short click (80–110 ms), fundamental 45–58 Hz, ending before 316 ms (one beat at 190); a short bass with
octaves, MIDI 31–46, at 40–50 ms; hats 12–14 kHz with 10–14 ms; glitch percussion; zap and laser FX
(`hipotese`, `:209-213`). Find them in the sample database (`style = 'hitech'`).

title: Style sheet — Hi-tech · Out of the style (`estudo`, `:234`)
text:
Long gates; continuous pads; a big reverb on the lead; BPM outside 170–220 for a long section; kick→bass sidechain
above ~200 BPM — at 250 ms per beat the ducking does not recover, and the separation becomes the 25–50 ms gate.
Do not apply levels twice (`:229`).

title: Style sheet — Hi-tech · Status and what is missing
text:
The most settled style: BPM, levels and master `decisao_diogo`; rhythm, sound and structure `codigo`. Everything
**heard** is missing: no A/B of PUNCH against the old clicks, the 4 racks not heard in their native form, the W-Core
bass presets not approved by ear yet.

title: Style sheet — Darkpsy, Twilight, Full-on, Progressive psy
text:
# Style sheet — Darkpsy, Twilight, Full-on, Progressive psy

Four labels with **one template each**, made with the genre's range from the online survey, until Diogo gives his
own (`core-template.md:74-80`). None has approved levels or master;
what is `codigo` comes from the files, the rest is `online`/`hipotese`.

text:
The numbers below were measured on the old templates (2026-11-04).
The Core-only templates keep the id, BPM, length and structure; their tracks and values are on the template pages:
`darkpsy`, `twilight`,
`fullon`, `progressive`.
